news.headline: JPMorgan Initiates Coverage on Nektar Therapeutics with Neutral Rating and $65 Price Target
news.summary: JPMorgan started NKTR at Neutral with a $65 target, roughly below the prior close and the second cautious voice after Wedbush's $80. It sits far under the Moderate Buy consensus target of about $141.50, where 10 analysts rate Buy, 2 Hold and 1 Sell, with Piper Sandler at $192 on the high end.

news.headline: Nektar Q2 2026 Earnings Call: Management Flags New Rezpeg Indication Study Before Year-End, TrialNet Type 1 Diabetes Data Due 2027
news.summary: On the call, CEO Howard Robin and R&D chief Jonathan Zalevsky said Nektar intends to start a clinical study in a new rezpegaldesleukin indication before the end of 2026, on top of the ongoing ZENITH AD Phase 3 program and the planned early-2027 alopecia areata Phase 3. They also reiterated that initial data from the TrialNet-sponsored Phase 2 study of rezpeg in new-onset Stage 3 Type 1 diabetes is expected in 2027.

news.headline: Earnings Update: Here's Why Analysts Just Lifted Their Nektar Therapeutics Price Target To US$153
news.summary: After the Q2 print the sell-side consensus target moved up to roughly $153, with B. Riley raising to $150 from $105, Citi reaffirming $151 and Piper Sandler holding $192. That left the average target roughly 100% above a share price near $76.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics (NKTR) Stock Slides As Cash Burn Clouds Pipeline Progress
news.summary: Quarterly revenue fell 9.4% year over year to $10.13 million while the trailing 12-month net loss widened 28.5% to $157.13 million, keeping the focus on burn as the Phase 3 program ramps. The stock slipped about 4% on the print and drifted lower afterwards despite the large EPS beat.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Cash and investments stood at $1,023.4 million on June 30, 2026 versus $245.8 million at year-end 2025, helped by the $373.8 million April equity offering, extending runway into Q3 2028 and past the targeted mid-2028 ZENITH AD readout. Net loss narrowed to $40.6 million ($1.23 per share) and CEO Howard Robin reaffirmed a Phase 3 alopecia areata start in early 2027 and a first rezpegaldesleukin BLA in 2029.

news.headline: Nektar Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program for Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar started ZENITH AD-1 and AD-2, two 510-patient global registrational trials in biologic/JAK-naive patients aged 12 and older, part of a roughly 1,530-patient program with a third study in treatment-experienced patients to follow in September. The design followed FDA end-of-Phase 2 meetings and EMA scientific advice, targeting initial topline data in mid-2028 and a BLA in 2029.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 initiation (biologic/JAK-experienced patients)
catalysts.detail: The third roughly 510-patient Phase 3 study, enrolling patients with prior systemic biologic and/or JAK inhibitor experience, is guided to begin in September 2026. It completes the registrational package for both U.S. and European filings and tests rezpeg in the harder-to-treat population.

catalysts.label: REZOLVE-AD / REZOLVE-AA data at EADV Congress 2026 (Vienna)
catalysts.detail: Two oral presentations are on the official EADV Congress 2026 schedule (Vienna, September 30-October 3): Dr. Thomas Bieber presenting deepening/durable REZOLVE-AD maintenance responses with monthly vs quarterly dosing, and Dr. David Rosmain presenting 52-week REZOLVE-AA alopecia areata efficacy and safety data. Durability of the Treg effect is a key swing factor ahead of the early-2027 alopecia areata Phase 3 start.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: The next quarterly report should update cash burn against the year-end guidance of $815-840 million, confirm the ZENITH AD-3 start and early enrollment across all three studies, and detail preparations for the early-2027 alopecia areata Phase 3. Date is a consensus estimate; Nektar has not yet issued a formal announcement.

catalysts.label: New rezpegaldesleukin indication study start
catalysts.detail: On the Q2 2026 earnings call management said Nektar intends to begin a clinical study in a new indication for rezpegaldesleukin before the end of 2026, beyond the existing atopic dermatitis, alopecia areata and Type 1 diabetes programs. No specific disease or start date has been disclosed yet.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 alopecia areata study start
catalysts.detail: Management reaffirmed on the Q2 call that it will start a single registrational Phase 3 study in severe alopecia areata in early 2027, based on the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA proof-of-concept data (28.2% mean SALT reduction on high dose vs 11.2% placebo at 36 weeks). Rezpeg already holds FDA Fast Track in this indication.

catalysts.label: TrialNet Phase 2 Type 1 diabetes data
catalysts.detail: Initial data from the TrialNet-sponsored Phase 2 study of rezpegaldesleukin in roughly 70 patients with new-onset Stage 3 Type 1 diabetes is expected in 2027, an externally-funded, low-cost optionality readout outside the core dermatology franchise.

catalysts.label: First ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline readout
catalysts.detail: Initial registrational efficacy data for rezpeg in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, the decisive binary event for the equity. Cash runway now extends into Q3 2028, covering this readout without a further raise.

catalysts.label: First rezpegaldesleukin BLA submission
catalysts.detail: Nektar has publicly guided to a first BLA filing for rezpegaldesleukin in 2029, following the mid-2028 ZENITH AD topline. The program was designed with EMA scientific advice in parallel, so a European filing is intended off the same dataset.

pulse: Nektar is a pure late-stage rezpeg story whose funding question is largely answered: Q2 2026 (reported August 13) showed $1.02 billion in cash and investments and runway into Q3 2028, past the mid-2028 ZENITH AD Phase 3 readout, with ZENITH AD-1/2 already underway since July, ZENITH AD-3 due to start in September 2026, and a registrational alopecia areata study in early 2027. Management used the August 20 earnings call to add two smaller catalysts to the story - a new rezpeg indication study slated to start before year-end 2026, and 2027 readout guidance for the externally-funded TrialNet Type 1 diabetes Phase 2 - while the core print itself was mixed, with a big EPS beat but revenue of $10.1 million slightly short and a widening loss from the Phase 3 ramp; the stock has since drifted into the mid-$70s, well below the 52-week high near $109. The sell-side remains split between the recent JPMorgan initiation at Neutral/$65 (August 21) and a consensus target near $141-153 (Piper Sandler at $192, B. Riley at $150, Citi at $151), leaving the next real catalyst as the REZOLVE-AD/REZOLVE-AA oral presentations on the EADV Congress 2026 agenda in Vienna (September 30-October 3), ahead of the ZENITH AD-3 study start guided for September.
